source_quotes_en:
2.4.5 
Working with Agile Solution Architects, Designers, and Builders 
Approach issues in an open manner, looking to generate agreed solutions from the many different 
stakeholders that may be involved. Do not start reviews with predefined ideas and solutions (unless 
there is a legal or regulatory reason why such ideas and solutions have to be applied); rather, 
clearly frame the issues and invite proposals from all. If possible, help to shape the review towards 
agreed solutions that respect many different viewpoints. 
You still have to lead, and you may have to make a final decision, but utilize the skills and 
capabilities of all in making your decisions.
observations.translation_zh:
2.4.5 与敏捷解决方案架构师、设计者和构建者协作

开放地处理问题，邀请可能涉及的多方利益相关者共同形成商定方案。除法律或监管要求必须采用特定思想或方案外，不应带着预设答案开始评审；应清楚框定问题，邀请所有人提出建议，尽可能引导评审形成尊重多个视点的共识。

仍须发挥领导作用，必要时作出最终决定，但决定应利用所有参与者的技能和能力。
observations.review_observation_zh: 先框定问题再邀提案，法律监管例外保留；领导与多方参与并存，不预设答案。

source_quotes_en:
2.4.6 
Responsibility for Overall Architecture Effectiveness 
As an Enterprise Architect you are responsible to senior management and potentially the 
Governing Board for the effective development and implementation of capabilities that will 
deliver their strategy and provide effective day-to-day operations. 
Agile practices emphasize that there are many contributors to doing this effectively and that 
knowledge and experience at the “sharp end” are crucial to creating the right blend of planned and 
emergent structure and solutions. 
Your main responsibility is to understand the interaction between these ways of delivering change 
and operations, and to lead across the full scope of the enterprise, addressing issues and conflicts 
as they emerge. 
In any enterprise of scale and complexity you will not have the view of the individual Agile change 
team that can focus on the smaller and more local issues; you have to address the broader and 
integrated view. Enterprise Architecture Governance is the ultimate oversight of the 
implementation of this enterprise viewpoint. 
 
 
The Agile Enterprise Architect Playbook, Version 1.0 
 
17
observations.translation_zh:
2.4.6 对整体架构有效性的责任

企业架构师向高级管理层，并可能向治理董事会负责，确保有效开发和实施能力，以落实战略并支持有效的日常运营。

敏捷实践强调众多贡献者的作用；一线的知识和经验对正确结合计划结构与涌现结构、形成方案十分关键。主责是理解这些交付变革和运营方式之间的互动，在企业全范围发挥领导作用，及时处理出现的问题与冲突。

在具有规模和复杂性的企业中，企业架构师不能仅采用某个敏捷变革团队关注局部问题的视角，必须处理更广泛、集成的视图。企业架构治理是落实这一企业视点的最终监督机制。
observations.review_observation_zh: 企业架构师对整体战略和运营有效性负责，视角跨团队；不是每个局部实现的替代岗位。

source_quotes_en:
3.1.2 
Support for Innovation in the TOGAF ADM 
The TOGAF ADM is intended to be customized to fit the local environment, and innovation can 
be applied in any phase. In particular, the standard specification covers innovation in Phase D 
(Technology Architecture) and Phase H (Architecture Change Management). Within Phase D, the 
potential to incorporate emerging technologies should be examined as a way to produce novel 
 
4 Design Thinking: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Design_thinking; 
Fish Bowl: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fishbowl_(conversation); 
6-3-5 Brainwriting: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/6-3-5_Brainwriting; 
Open Space Technology (OST): https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Open_Space_Technology; 
World Café: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_caf%C3%A9_(conversation). 
 
18 
 
The Open Group Guide (2022) 
solutions. Within Phase H, the potential for innovation in business process or technology is 
recognized as a driver for change. 
Adopting new and innovative business practices or technology will often require considerable 
change, so an assessment of the readiness of an organization to transform can be useful. The 
TOGAF Standard includes a Business Transformation Readiness Assessment process, which 
enables a detailed assessment of an organization’s readiness to enact a business transformation. It 
examines factors such as the desire and need for change, funding availability, sponsorship, and 
ability to execute. The assessment could be a precursor to a particularly disruptive business 
transformation, where the change necessary is considerable.
observations.translation_zh:
3.1.2 ADM对创新的支持

ADM本就应按本地环境定制，任意阶段都可创新。标准特别在D技术架构中要求考察新兴技术形成新方案的可能性，在H架构变更管理中将业务流程或技术创新视作变更驱动。

采用创新业务实践或技术常需显著变化，因而可先评估组织转型准备度。标准的业务转型准备度评估详细考察变革意愿和需要、资金、赞助及执行能力；在所需变更很大的颠覆性转型之前，这种评估尤其有用。
observations.review_observation_zh: 创新可在所有阶段，D新技术与H变更驱动的重点区别保留；重大转型可先评估准备度。

source_quotes_en:
3.2.1 
How is the MVA Applied in the TOGAF Standard? 
The TOGAF Standard supports the MVA pattern. Since the order, iteration, and components of 
the TOGAF Standard are defined by the enterprise, the scope can be aligned to a Transition 
Architecture. It is a continuous architecture process that is a way to define, build, and refactor the 
architecture of a system of systems to reflect the current understanding of the business need and 
whether the current solution is fit-for-purpose. 
Rather than having the Architecture Definition Document defined before the starting development 
of the first major release, break it up into many short internal releases framed by less frequent 
external releases. Each minor release contains additional or modified ABBs and SBBs. Some 
building blocks will be deployed but not released since they are required for future function. As 
requirements are better understood, you may actually need to deactivate a building block.
observations.translation_zh:
3.2.1 TOGAF如何应用MVA

TOGAF支持MVA模式。企业自行定义标准的顺序、迭代和组成，范围可与过渡架构对齐。这是持续定义、构建、重构系统之系统的架构过程，反映对当前业务需要及方案适用性的理解。

不必在首个主要版本开发前完成全部架构定义文档，可以拆成多个短周期内部版本，由较低频的外部发布框定。每个小版本增加或修改ABB和SBB。有些构建块为未来功能所需，已经部署但尚未发布；需求理解深化后也可能需要停用构建块。
observations.review_observation_zh: MVA基于有意架构；短内部版本和外部发布区分，部署但不发布及停用均保留。

source_quotes_en:
3.2.2 
Using an MVA in the Real World 
We developed an eCommerce Software as a Service (SaaS) product which enabled customers to 
develop and host eCommerce sites with their own brands. The technology was brand new and 
needed to be integrated with legacy products and refactor code from a previous failed project. 
Because the user experience was not defined and needed to be validated through focus groups, we 
created many small releases using an MVA approach. With each small release we were able to get 
user feedback that helped us to define a marketable product. Given that the product was based on 
modular services, we were able to add or modify the architecture at each release. We did first 
create an intentional architecture for the foundation. 
A challenge with this approach was that user interface standards frequently changed, resulting in 
high recoding. 
 
The Agile Enterprise Architect Playbook, Version 1.0 
 
19
observations.translation_zh:
3.2.2 现实中的MVA应用

作者案例：团队开发可让客户以自身品牌开发、托管电商站点的SaaS产品，使用全新技术，需集成遗留产品，并重构先前失败项目的代码。

用户体验尚未定义，需通过焦点小组验证，因此采用MVA形成很多小版本，每次获取用户反馈，逐步定义可销售产品。模块化服务使每次发布均可新增、修改架构；团队先建立了作为基础的有意架构。挑战是界面标准频繁变化，导致大量代码重写。

这是来源作者经验，不代表当前项目已经发生的事实。
observations.review_observation_zh: SaaS和频繁UI重写是来源作者经验，未转成当前项目事实。

source_quotes_en:
3.3.1 
Communicating with Stakeholders about Architecture 
When you read about stakeholders in most literature and training, it is about how to manage the 
stakeholders. There are a few recurring patterns on how to identify and classify your stakeholders. 
You can find detailed examples of this in the TOGAF Standard – ADM Techniques, §3 
(Stakeholder Management) [TOGAF 2022]. 
But in an Agile context you don’t manage stakeholders, you collaborate with them. It is the 
outside-in focus instead of the inside-out, where you try to control the stakeholders. Enterprise 
Architecture stakeholders including external customers need to become involved across the entire 
architecture lifecycle. 
Think about how you can involve the stakeholders in your architecture work. You have to ensure 
that stakeholders are involved in not just the presentations and reviews of the results of each 
iteration, but also in decision-making across the entire product lifecycle. 
 
5 Copyright © 2001 Alistair Cockburn [Cockburn 2001]. 
 
20 
 
The Open Group Guide (2022) 
They are the customers of your architecture and the implementation of it. Think and talk about the 
business value; not just financial, but other types of value such as ease of change, effective and 
happy staff, delighted customers. Different values will attract different types of stakeholders 
getting them involved instead of managed. You can get so much valuable important information 
from them if you manage to involve and understand them. Let the stakeholders collaborate with 
each other and you and together you will find the correct path forward.
observations.translation_zh:
3.3.1 与利益相关者沟通架构

常见文献和培训侧重如何管理、识别和分类利益相关者，详细示例见《ADM技术》第3章。但敏捷语境强调协作、由外向内，避免只从内部设法控制他们。包括外部客户在内的EA利益相关者，需要参与整个架构生命周期，不只是迭代成果演示和评审，也参与产品全生命周期的决策。

他们是架构及其实施的客户。讨论业务价值时，不仅看财务，也看易于变更、员工有效且愉快工作、客户满意等价值。不同价值吸引不同利益相关者参与；理解并让他们彼此及与架构师协作，能获得重要信息，共同寻找前进路径。
observations.review_observation_zh: 协作不止演示评审，还包括决策；非财务价值与客户外向内保留。

source_quotes_en:
3.4.1.1 
How the TOGAF ADM Supports the Enterprise Architect Role 
The TOGAF Standard is designed to complement any deliverable by all roles: Enterprise 
Architects, Segment Architects, and Solution Architects. 
Agile Enterprise Architecture is supported by the TOGAF ADM by allowing any phase to be 
executed concurrently by the Agile development team. 
The TOGAF Standard and the Enterprise Architect make sure that the long-term strategies and 
goals of the enterprise are understood by the Agile development team. 
The architect has a responsibility for ensuring the completeness (fitness-for-purpose) of the 
architecture, in terms of adequately addressing all the pertinent concerns of its stakeholders; and 
the integrity of the architecture, in terms of connecting all the various views to each other, 
satisfactorily reconciling the conflicting concerns of different stakeholders, and showing the trade-
offs made in so doing (as between security and performance, for example). 
 
22 
 
The Open Group Guide (2022) 
The choice of which particular architecture views to develop is one of the key decisions that the 
Enterprise Architect has to make. The choice has to be constrained by considerations of 
practicality, and by the principle of fitness-for-purpose (i.e., the architecture should be developed 
only to the point at which it is fit-for-purpose, and not reiterated ad infinitum as an academic 
exercise).
observations.translation_zh:
3.4.1.1 ADM如何支持企业架构师角色

TOGAF旨在支持企业、分段、解决方案架构师各类角色的交付；允许敏捷开发团队并行执行阶段。标准和企业架构师确保团队理解企业长期战略和目标。

架构师对适用性负责：充分处理利益相关者的全部相关关注点；也对完整一致性负责：连接各视图，协调冲突关注点，展示例如安全与性能的取舍。选择开发哪些视图是关键决策，受实用性和适用性约束，只做到满足目的，不作无止境的学术迭代。
observations.review_observation_zh: 完整性按关注点和适用性判断，一致性连接视图并展示冲突取舍。

source_quotes_en:
3.4.2 
Agile Management Roles 
There are a number of management roles to be aware of in an Agile organization, particularly in 
a hybrid Agile environment. Below are some examples, together with a proposed simple definition 
of each. 
• 
The Portfolio Manager works with groups of programs, separate projects, and other 
activities aimed to achieve one strategic goal 
• 
The Program Manager works with several related projects that pursue a bigger common 
goal 
They focuses on higher-level management of these projects. This includes 
interdependencies, risks, the economics of the whole program, as well as the work 
required to coordinate the work of several Project Managers. 
 
The Agile Enterprise Architect Playbook, Version 1.0 
 
23 
• 
The Product Manager identifies the customer need and the larger business objectives 
that will articulate what success looks like for a product 
• 
The Project Manager leads one or several separate projects responsible for cost 
• 
The Product Owner is a member of an Agile product team responsible for defining user 
stories and prioritizing the backlog, ensuring these are understood by other team members 
while maintaining the conceptual integrity of the features or components for the delivery 
team 
• 
The Scrum Master is involved in the day-to-day processes of the product development 
process; they oversee the implementation of the Scrum process
observations.translation_zh:
3.4.2 敏捷管理角色

敏捷组织，特别是混合敏捷环境中的管理角色示例及简要定义：

- 组合经理（Portfolio Manager）：管理面向同一战略目标的项目群、独立项目和其他活动。
- 项目群经理（Program Manager）：管理追求更大共同目标的相关项目，处理高层依赖、风险、整体经济性和多位项目经理的协调。
- 产品经理（Product Manager）：识别客户需要及更大业务目标，明确产品成功的含义。
- 项目经理（Project Manager）：领导一个或多个独立项目，对成本负责。
- 产品负责人（Product Owner）：定义用户故事、排序积压，使队员理解，维护交付特征或组件的概念完整性。
- Scrum Master：参与日常产品开发流程，监督Scrum流程实施。
observations.review_observation_zh: 组合、项目群、产品、项目、PO及Scrum Master按源定义分开，不造汇报树。

source_quotes_en:
3.4.3 
Focus on Collaboration in the TOGAF ADM 
Preliminary Phase 
The (Scrum of) Scrum Master and chief Enterprise Architect collaborate to define the interaction 
between the Enterprise Architect and Agile development teams. 
Phase A (Architecture Vision) 
The Product Manager and Enterprise Architecture team interact to create the vision of the product. 
Phases B to E (Architecting Phases) 
The Product Manager, Product Owner, and Enterprise Architecture team interact to define the 
architecture of the product. 
 
24 
 
The Open Group Guide (2022) 
Phase E (Opportunities & Solutions) 
The Project Manager, Product Owner, and the Enterprise Architecture team interact to define the 
work products and the Architecture Roadmaps. 
Phase F (Migration Planning) 
The Scrum Manager, Project Manager, and the Enterprise Architecture team interact to confirm 
management framework interactions for the Implementation and Migration Plan. 
The Project Manager and the Enterprise Architecture team interact to define the Implementation 
and Migration Plan, risks, and business values of work packages.
observations.translation_zh:
3.4.3 ADM中的协作重点

预备阶段，Scrum of Scrums的Scrum Master与首席企业架构师共同定义架构师和敏捷开发团队的互动；A阶段产品经理与EA团队形成产品愿景；B—E阶段产品经理、产品负责人和EA团队定义产品架构。

E阶段项目经理、产品负责人、EA团队定义工作产品和架构路线图。F阶段来源称Scrum Manager、项目经理及EA团队共同确认实施迁移计划的管理框架交互；项目经理与EA团队定义实施迁移计划、风险及工作包业务价值。保留来源的Scrum Manager措辞，不擅自等同于人事管理岗位。
observations.review_observation_zh: B—E产品架构、E工作产品、F管理交互与迁移计划分别保留；源Scrum Manager不擅改。

source_quotes_en:
3.5.2 
Enterprise Architecture Role in Agile Acquisition 
What is the role of Enterprise Architecture and architects in an Agile acquisition? Just as in any 
other acquisition, Enterprise Architecture is important. The Enterprise Architect does not only 
look at the acquisition, but also how that acquisition will fit into the larger picture of the entire 
business and IT landscape (the context) of the purchaser and the long-term relations with the 
provider. 
 
The Agile Enterprise Architect Playbook, Version 1.0 
 
25 
Trust 
The most important aspect of Agile acquisition is the trust between the two partners: the purchaser 
and the provider. Enterprise Architecture can be part of creating that trust from different 
perspectives: 
• 
Ensure that the provider understands the environment within the purchaser; the business, 
IT, and finance environment, including their culture and Agile experiences 
• 
Ensure that the purchaser understands the environment within the provider; the business, 
IT, and finance environment, including their culture and Agile experiences 
• 
Develop an evolving outcome-based incremental Enterprise Architecture in collaboration 
with the supplier architects based on strategic objectives and goals and qualities 
• 
Make sure the purchaser and the supplier can deliver the needed hard decisions just in 
time 
Governance/Support 
Govern/support the implementation together with the supplier architects: 
• 
Ensure stakeholder participation (purchaser and supplier) in demos, retrospectives, and 
sprint planning and even daily scrum meetings 
• 
Ensure that the purchaser has the final say in decisions and ensure they are well analyzed 
and agreed
observations.translation_zh:
3.5.2 敏捷采购中的EA角色

企业架构师不仅看采购本身，也看其如何适配采购方整体业务和IT全景，以及与供应方的长期关系。

信任是双方最重要的方面。EA应帮助供应方理解采购方的业务、IT、财务环境、文化和敏捷经验，也帮助采购方理解供应方相同背景；与供应商架构师基于战略目标和质量要求，共同形成基于结果、增量演进的EA；确保双方及时作出必要的困难决策。

实施治理与支持也应协作开展：让双方利益相关者参与演示、回顾、冲刺规划，甚至每日Scrum；确保采购方有最终决定权，同时使决定得到充分分析并取得一致理解。
observations.review_observation_zh: 采购双方互相理解、共同治理；采购方最终决定仍需充分分析。

source_quotes_en:
3.6.2 
Rolling Forecasts and Enterprise Architecture 
Enterprise Architecture is an important stakeholder in the budgeting of an organization. The 
Transition Architectures and MVAs created are constantly input to the rolling budget. 
In an Agile environment, the architectures and solutions are created incrementally with a 
constantly improved understanding of their costs and business values. This enables the 
organization to continuously maintain their rolling budget based on the best information available. 
Each Transition Architecture consists of roadmaps, work packages, migration plans, and business 
cases for that transition which fits perfectly into the rolling forecast and also the portfolio 
management of the new and existing initiatives and their budgets, giving a more granular budget 
and planning understanding due to the incremental approach. 
A rolling forecast can be equated to the refactoring concept often used in an Agile development.
observations.translation_zh:
3.6.2 滚动预测与EA

EA是预算的重要利益相关者，过渡架构和MVA持续输入滚动预算。敏捷环境中架构和方案增量形成，对成本和业务价值的理解不断改善，使预算依据最佳现有信息持续更新。

各过渡架构的路线图、工作包、迁移计划、业务案例，适合与滚动预测、新旧举措的组合管理及预算衔接，带来更细粒度的预算规划理解。原文把滚动预测比作敏捷开发常用的重构概念。
observations.review_observation_zh: 滚动预测使用不断改善的成本价值理解，过渡架构输入预算，不代表预算已经批准。

source_quotes_en:
4.1.9 
Collaboration Between TOGAF and Agile Solution Development 
The TOGAF architecture can be developed on its own, using Agile practices like Scrum, but often 
the Enterprise Architecture team needs to collaborate with other Agile teams. The most common 
collaborating partners are the Agile solution development teams. 
The Agile Enterprise Architecture team creates MVAs using one or more sprints. These MVAs 
are the input to the Agile solution development backlogs. 
 
Figure 7: Enterprise Architecture and Agile Development Sprints 
This will create positive effects: 
• 
The business change stakeholders will have an earlier understanding of what they will 
receive from the demos 
• 
Agile solution teams involved in creating and implementing the Enterprise Architecture 
ensures better architecture 
• 
Agile solution teams’ decisions and concerns are fed back to architects quickly 
• 
Agile solution teams involved in creating and implementing the Enterprise Architecture 
ensures enhanced business value 
• 
Agile solution teams understand the effects of Enterprise Architecture decisions quickly 
and can give feedback
observations.translation_zh:
4.1.9 TOGAF与敏捷解决方案开发协作

TOGAF架构可以自行使用Scrum等敏捷实践开发，但EA团队经常需与其他敏捷团队，尤其解决方案开发团队协作。EA团队用一个或多个冲刺创建MVA，再作为解决方案开发积压的输入。

图7：企业架构与敏捷开发冲刺。沿愿景/零号冲刺及EA冲刺序列，配合敏捷开发冲刺，并有评审、回顾、规划。原图保留，不假定一对一数量或固定同步节拍。

这使业务变革利益相关者从演示更早理解将获得什么；方案团队参与EA创建和实施，改善架构及业务价值；其决策与关注点快速反馈给架构师；方案团队快速理解EA决策影响并提供反馈。
observations.review_observation_zh: MVA输入解决方案积压，方案团队反馈架构，不推断图中固定冲刺比例。

source_quotes_en:
4.2.1 
Support of the Agile Practice in the TOGAF ADM 
The TOGAF ADM describes many artifacts (catalogs, matrices, and diagrams) that define various 
aspects of architecture. These may be created by a variety of word processor or presentation tools, 
diagramming tools, or modeling tools. The TOGAF Standard – Architecture Content, §4 
(Architecture Deliverables) [TOGAF 2022] describes the deliverables containing these artifacts, 
most of which would manifest themselves as documents that are generated during the architecture 
project. 
The ADM phase descriptions specify which artifacts and deliverables should be input and output. 
However, the Standard does not specify how the artifacts and deliverables should materialize in 
your documents; for example, there is no specification of any particular standard document format 
or standard template.67 Therefore, the format can be chosen to suit the local environment; for 
example, an architecture toolset or a DevOps toolchain.
observations.translation_zh:
4.2.1 ADM对敏捷实践的支持

ADM描述定义架构各方面的目录、矩阵和图，可由文字处理、演示、绘图、建模工具创建。《架构内容》第4章描述包含这些制品的交付物，多表现为架构项目产生的文档。

阶段说明规定输入输出制品和交付物，但不规定它们在文档中的具体实现形式，没有强制的标准格式或模板，可以适配本地环境，例如架构工具集或DevOps工具链。

脚注6：TOGAF Library有示例模板，但不是标准的一部分。脚注7：以ArchiMate建模TOGAF制品的指导见《如何使用ArchiMate建模语言支持TOGAF标准》[ArchiMate 2022]。
observations.review_observation_zh: 标准规定输入输出类型，但不规定固定文档格式；Library模板不属于标准本体。

source_quotes_en:
4.2.2 
Agile Documentation in Practice 
You should document only the minimum content necessary to enable the next step. This means: 
• 
Documentation is produced incrementally, and with an expectation of change 
Early increments should focus on short statements of vision and principles, and diagrams 
showing high-level structures and relationships. 
• 
For some steps, the minimum necessary may be zero 
• 
Towards the end of an architecture project, the “minimum content necessary” will be 
whatever is necessary in the future development and operation of the solution; this will 
not be zero 
• 
Documentation tools and formats: 
— Give preference to tools and formats which enable fine-grain collaboration; for 
example, documents in markup formats held within a code management system, and 
tools supporting multiple simultaneous editors 
 
6 There are example templates within the TOGAF Library, but these are not part of the TOGAF Standard. 
7 Guidance on modeling TOGAF artifacts in the ArchiMate modeling language can be found in The Open Group Guide: How to Use 
the ArchiMate® Modeling Language to Support the TOGAF® Standard [ArchiMate 2022]. 
 
The Agile Enterprise Architect Playbook, Version 1.0 
 
33 
— Automation features such as approval workflows can increase efficiency and reduce 
cycle times 
— The scale and complexity of an endeavor can influence the choice of tools; for 
example, for small-scale work, commodity office tools and shared folders may be 
sufficient; however, for large projects, purpose-made modeling tools may be beneficial 
Accessibility over long periods of time should also be considered, which can become an issue for 
artifacts stored within a toolset repository. Toolsets naturally evolve and change over time, and 
there is a risk that old content can become inaccessible. One solution has been to export 
documentation to long-established file formats such as PDF.
observations.translation_zh:
4.2.2 实践中的敏捷文档

只记录使下一步可行的最少必要内容：增量产生并预期变化；早期聚焦简短愿景和原则以及高层结构关系图；某些步骤最低内容可为零；到项目结束，必须保留未来方案开发、运营所需内容，此时不会为零。

优先选择支持细粒度协作的工具格式，如代码管理系统中的标记文档、多人同时编辑工具；审批流程自动化可提高效率、缩短周期。规模复杂性影响选型，小工作可用办公工具和共享目录，大项目可能适合专门建模工具。

还应考虑长期可访问性，工具集会演进变化，存储库内旧制品可能变得不可访问；一种做法是导出为PDF等长期通用格式。
observations.review_observation_zh: 最低文档按下一步而定；末期运营所需内容不会为零，保留长期可访问性。

source_quotes_en:
4.3.1 
Pair Architecting in the TOGAF ADM 
Preliminary Phase 
Pair architecting ways of working are defined. Define pairing roles and responsibilities. 
Phases A to F and Architecture Requirements Management 
Define the TOGAF artifacts in pairs where the benefits are high; e.g., create common 
understanding, get expert help, make decisions. 
Phase G (Implementation Governance) 
Work in pairs to handle support and compliance reviews to ensure a consistent message. 
 
34 
 
The Open Group Guide (2022)
observations.translation_zh:
4.3.1 ADM中的结对架构

预备阶段定义结对方式、角色和职责；A—F及架构需求管理，在有助共同理解、获得专家支持或作出决策时结对定义TOGAF制品；G实施治理阶段结对开展支持与符合性评审，确保传递一致信息。
observations.review_observation_zh: 结对在预备阶段定义职责；A—F和需求管理按价值使用；G支持及合规消息一致。

source_quotes_en:
4.3.2 
Pair Architecting Example 
When creating the Security Architecture for a product, we collaborated in work sessions on a 
model connecting the ISO/IEC 27001/28 way of working to the necessary processes, IT 
components, and services. The work sessions were done both face-to-face using a large screen for 
collaboration and remotely using conference tools from home. One of us would manage the model 
and we would switch roles depending on the expertise of the participants. 
 
 
8 ISO/IEC 27001: Information Security Management; ISO/IEC 27002: Information Technology – Security Techniques – Code of 
Practice for Information Security Controls. 
 
The Agile Enterprise Architect Playbook, Version 1.0 
 
35
